stories.capability: see which country the storefront is shipping to and which currency it is pricing in, stated as standing text I can act on
stories.benefit: I never get several screens deep before discovering the prices I have been reading are not the ones I would pay

acceptance_criteria.given: the storefront has inferred a delivery country from my location
acceptance_criteria.then: an assist chip states the delivery country and the display currency, and it does not auto-dismiss

acceptance_criteria.given: the locale chip is visible
acceptance_criteria.then: the Delivery & currency screen opens

acceptance_criteria.given: I have previously confirmed a delivery country that contradicts the inference
acceptance_criteria.then: the confirmed country is shown and no banner reappears

acceptance_criteria.given: locale inference is unavailable
acceptance_criteria.then: the chip reads 'Set delivery country' and routes to the same screen rather than guessing one

acceptance_criteria.given: the catalogue request has failed
acceptance_criteria.then: the locale chip is still live, because it is read from local state rather than the failed call

stories.capability: pick a delivery country and see a real item re-priced in the resulting currency before I commit to it
stories.benefit: I can tell whether the change gives me the prices I expected instead of committing and finding out afterwards

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on Delivery & currency
acceptance_criteria.then: the preview card re-prices one representative item in that country's currency

acceptance_criteria.given: a re-price request is in flight
acceptance_criteria.then: the preview holds its previous value at disabled opacity beside a progress indicator, and the save button is disabled rather than hidden

acceptance_criteria.given: the selected country does not ship the representative item
acceptance_criteria.then: it says so plainly instead of showing a converted price

acceptance_criteria.given: the selected currency has no minor units
acceptance_criteria.then: no trailing decimal places are shown

acceptance_criteria.given: I have selected a country but not saved
acceptance_criteria.then: the pending selection is discarded and the previously confirmed country is unchanged

stories.capability: have the delivery country I chose stay chosen even when the server does not acknowledge it
stories.benefit: the price I am shown is the one I asked for, so I can trust a summary of what was picked and what it costs

acceptance_criteria.given: I tap save and the local write succeeds
acceptance_criteria.when: the network call to persist it fails
acceptance_criteria.then: the local value is kept, a retry runs in the background, and the choice is never silently reverted

acceptance_criteria.given: I am offline
acceptance_criteria.then: the country list renders from cache, the preview is suppressed with an inline note, and saving is still allowed

acceptance_criteria.given: a country is served by more than one currency
acceptance_criteria.then: a second choice is offered rather than a currency being assumed

stories.capability: commit the words I typed without depending on the suggestion list appearing or resolving
stories.benefit: pressing enter always produces results, so I never have to work out why nothing happened

acceptance_criteria.given: I have typed a query
acceptance_criteria.then: the search is committed and Results opens with that exact string

acceptance_criteria.given: I have typed a query
acceptance_criteria.when: I tap the trailing submit button
acceptance_criteria.then: exactly the same thing happens as with the keyboard action

acceptance_criteria.given: suggestions have not loaded
acceptance_criteria.when: I tap the first row holding my literal query
acceptance_criteria.then: the search is committed without waiting for suggestions

acceptance_criteria.given: the suggestion service has failed
acceptance_criteria.then: the suggestion list is omitted and both the literal-query row and the submit button remain

acceptance_criteria.given: I have typed only whitespace
acceptance_criteria.when: I look at the submit button
acceptance_criteria.then: it is disabled rather than routing to an empty result set

acceptance_criteria.given: I submit twice in quick succession
acceptance_criteria.then: one Results screen is pushed, not two

stories.capability: read every result's price in the currency I chose, and change that choice mid-list without losing my place
stories.benefit: I can compare options against a budget I actually hold, without restarting the scan every time I adjust the locale

acceptance_criteria.given: results are rendered
acceptance_criteria.then: the price is shown in the active currency with the secondary-currency line directly beneath it

acceptance_criteria.given: I have scrolled some way into the list
acceptance_criteria.when: I change the delivery country from the locale chip and return
acceptance_criteria.then: prices re-render in place and my scroll position is preserved

acceptance_criteria.given: a currency conversion is unavailable for one result
acceptance_criteria.then: only the primary price is shown, never a placeholder or a stale rate

acceptance_criteria.given: an item is unavailable for the selected delivery country
acceptance_criteria.then: it is dimmed at disabled opacity and states why

acceptance_criteria.given: paging returns an item already loaded
acceptance_criteria.then: the duplicate is removed before render

stories.capability: reach the add control at any scroll position without hunting for it or scrolling sideways
stories.benefit: the action I opened the product to take is always one tap away, whatever else I am reading

acceptance_criteria.given: I am anywhere on the product screen
acceptance_criteria.when: I look at the bottom of the viewport
acceptance_criteria.then: the docked action bar is visible above the bottom inset, holding the quantity stepper and the add button

acceptance_criteria.given: the product details are still loading
acceptance_criteria.then: the docked bar is already present and disabled, so its position is established before content arrives

acceptance_criteria.given: the product has no media
acceptance_criteria.then: a tonal placeholder is used rather than a collapse, so the docked bar does not jump

acceptance_criteria.given: the docked bar is visible
acceptance_criteria.when: I scroll the specification list to its end
acceptance_criteria.then: the bar has reserved its own layout height and has not covered any row

acceptance_criteria.given: I tap add twice in quick succession
acceptance_criteria.then: one line is posted with quantity two, not two lines

stories.capability: know that adding to the cart cannot become checking out by accident
stories.benefit: the boundary I set on the task holds without anyone having to steer carefully around a button

acceptance_criteria.given: the docked action bar is rendered
acceptance_criteria.then: it holds no checkout affordance of any kind

acceptance_criteria.given: I tap add to cart
acceptance_criteria.then: the item is in the cart and no checkout flow has been entered

acceptance_criteria.given: the add request fails
acceptance_criteria.then: the button returns to its enabled label and a snackbar states what happened and offers a retry

acceptance_criteria.given: the price changed between render and add
acceptance_criteria.then: the cart price is treated as authoritative and the difference is stated rather than absorbed silently

stories.capability: come back to the cart and find the add still confirmed, with a subtotal that has not disappeared
stories.benefit: I can stop, check something else, and return without re-verifying that the item ever landed

acceptance_criteria.given: I added an item and navigated away
acceptance_criteria.then: the line is present with its quantity and price in the active currency

acceptance_criteria.given: the cart is loading
acceptance_criteria.then: placeholder lines are shown and the totals block is suppressed rather than showing a zero that will change

acceptance_criteria.given: the cart request fails
acceptance_criteria.then: the last known line count stays visible, so I am never told my cart is empty when it is not

acceptance_criteria.given: a line is unavailable for the newly selected delivery country
acceptance_criteria.then: that line is dimmed, excluded from the subtotal, and the exclusion is stated above the total

stories.capability: change a line quantity or remove a line and undo that removal
stories.benefit: I can correct a mistake without rebuilding the cart from the search results

acceptance_criteria.given: a line is in the cart
acceptance_criteria.when: I step its quantity up or down
acceptance_criteria.then: the line price and the subtotal re-total in place

acceptance_criteria.given: a line is at quantity one
acceptance_criteria.then: a dialog asks me to confirm removal before anything is deleted

acceptance_criteria.given: I confirm a removal
acceptance_criteria.then: a snackbar offers an undo, and taking it restores the line

acceptance_criteria.given: the removal has already committed on the server
acceptance_criteria.then: the line is re-added and I am told that is what happened, rather than the undo failing quietly

acceptance_criteria.given: a requested quantity exceeds the stock cap
acceptance_criteria.then: the stepper clamps and states the cap rather than failing later at checkout
